tex_content.html:
\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch3:3.3

  1. Show that for every smooth manifold $M$, conformality is an equivalence relation on the set of all Riemannian metrics on $M$.

  2. Show that conformal equivalence is an equivalence relation on the class of all Riemannian manifolds.

\end{exercise}
